site.name: Lense and Sensibility
site.author: Amit Singh
about: I'm Amit Singh, PhD. I've worked as a scientist and a professor, and today I'm a Senior Staff RF Engineer at Lam Research, working on the RF generators and plasma sources inside semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

My career has taken me across Asia and the US, and a camera comes along wherever I go. Lense and Sensibility is where I share the photographs I like best, one collection per tab. Tap any photo to see it full screen with a short note about the moment.
site.welcome: Photographs from trips and slow days with a camera.

albums.title: Mysore Trip
albums.label: Mysore Zoo · 2026
albums.heading: The elephant's
albums.subtitle: Seventeen photographs from a day at Mysore Zoo, from basking crocodiles to a sleeping leopard.
albums.intro: I spent a slow day at Mysore Zoo with a long lens, waiting for small moments: a deer turning its head, a baboon pausing on its perch, a hippo resting its chin. Tap any photo to see it full screen with a short note about the animal.

photos.title: The elephant's dust bath
photos.subtitle: Asian elephant
photos.story: She curled her trunk and tossed a cloud of dust over her back. A dust coat works like sunscreen and keeps biting insects away.
photos.alt: An Asian elephant throwing dust over its back, framed by tall trees

photos.title: Resting chin
photos.subtitle: Hippopotamus
photos.story: Up close, the wet skin shows every fold and bump. Hippos give off a reddish oily fluid that protects their skin from the sun.
photos.alt: Close-up side profile of a wet hippopotamus resting its chin on a concrete ledge

photos.title: Seen from above
photos.subtitle: Gharial
photos.story: Looking straight down shows the thin snout, built for snapping up fish. The gharial is one of the rarest crocodilians on Earth.
photos.alt: A gharial seen from directly above, its long thin snout pointing across green water

photos.title: The herd turns to look
photos.subtitle: Spotted deer (chital)
photos.story: One stag looked up, then the whole herd followed. Each chital keeps its white spots for life.
photos.alt: A herd of spotted deer under trees, several turned toward the camera

photos.title: On the lookout
photos.subtitle: Hamadryas baboon
photos.story: The silver mane marks him as an adult male. The pink bougainvillea behind him made a soft, colorful background.
photos.alt: A silver-maned hamadryas baboon standing on a wooden platform, pink flowers behind

photos.title: Quiet company
photos.subtitle: Chimpanzee
photos.story: One chimp sat hugging his knees and held my gaze for a long moment. A peahen walks along the wall behind them.
photos.alt: Two chimpanzees sitting on a log platform, one hugging its knees and looking at the camera

photos.title: Teeth in the shade
photos.subtitle: Crocodile
photos.story: Two crocodiles rest under a log bench beside the pool. Even with the jaws shut, the teeth stay on show.
photos.alt: Two crocodiles resting under a wooden log bench beside a green pool

photos.title: Watching the fence
photos.subtitle: Lion
photos.story: She stood perfectly still behind the rock, watching something along the fence line.
photos.alt: A lioness standing behind a large rock, looking along the enclosure fence

photos.title: Waiting on the log
photos.subtitle: Rhesus macaque
photos.story: Plain wall, green grass, and one monkey on a hollow log. The simple background lets him stand out.
photos.alt: A rhesus macaque sitting on a hollow log in green grass

photos.title: Afternoon nap
photos.subtitle: Leopard
photos.story: One leopard sleeps flat out on the wooden platform while a second dozes in the shade below. Leopards rest for most of the day and hunt mainly at night.
photos.alt: A leopard asleep on a raised wooden platform in front of a stone wall, a second leopard lying below

photos.title: Painted in pink
photos.subtitle: Painted stork
photos.story: Shot from below against the aviary roof. The pink feathers near the tail give the painted stork its name, and the heavy yellow bill is made for catching fish.
photos.alt: Close-up of a painted stork with a pink face and long yellow bill, standing on a branch

photos.title: Adults and young
photos.subtitle: Black-crowned night heron
photos.story: An adult perches on top of the leaves while two streaky brown juveniles sit lower down. The young birds take about three years to get the grey-and-white adult colours.
photos.alt: An adult black-crowned night heron standing on broad green leaves, with two brown-streaked juveniles to its left

facts.label: Native to
facts.value: Every continent except Australia and Antarctica

photos.title: Hay on their backs
photos.subtitle: Asian elephants
photos.story: Three elephants head off after feeding, with loose hay still piled on their backs. Elephants often toss food and dust over themselves.
photos.alt: Three Asian elephants seen from behind walking across a dirt enclosure, hay on their backs

photos.title: Ears up
photos.subtitle: Sambar deer
photos.story: A hind stands alert while a stag rests behind her. Sambar are the largest deer in India, and only the stags grow antlers.
photos.alt: A sambar hind standing in a muddy enclosure with a resting antlered stag behind her

photos.title: Long stride
photos.subtitle: Giraffe
photos.story: A giraffe strides past the railing, its long neck reaching toward the trees. Every giraffe has its own coat pattern, like a fingerprint.
photos.alt: A giraffe walking past a black railing, seen side-on, with green trees behind

photos.title: Sharing the treetop
photos.subtitle: Painted stork and night herons
photos.story: Inside the aviary, a painted stork towers over the night herons perched around it in the same tree.
photos.alt: A painted stork standing in a leafy tree inside a netted aviary, several night herons perched nearby

photos.title: The ride around
photos.subtitle: Zoo shuttle
photos.story: Battery-powered carts carry visitors along the shaded paths between the enclosures.
photos.alt: A green battery-powered cart carrying visitors along a paved path lined with trees and bamboo

albums.title: Singapore Zoo
albums.label: Singapore Zoo · 2017
albums.heading: A cheetah's
albums.subtitle: Eight photographs from Singapore Zoo, from a watchful cheetah to a coiled green tree python.
albums.intro: From a 2017 trip to Singapore Zoo, where the animals live in open, rainforest-style enclosures. Tap any photo to see it full screen with a short note about the animal.

photos.title: Sitting tall
photos.subtitle: Cheetah
photos.story: The cheetah sat up on the grass and looked straight at the camera. The black tear lines under its eyes are thought to cut glare from the sun.
photos.alt: A cheetah sitting upright on green grass, facing the camera

photos.title: The long look
photos.subtitle: Lion
photos.story: A lioness resting with her paws crossed, giving the camera a slow, sleepy stare. Lions can rest for up to 20 hours a day.
photos.alt: Close portrait of a lioness lying down with her front paws crossed, dark leaves behind

photos.title: Coiled and waiting
photos.subtitle: Green tree python
photos.story: Neat coils over a branch with the head tucked in the middle, the classic green tree python pose. The young are born yellow or red and turn green as they grow.
photos.alt: A bright green snake coiled in loops over a branch, its head resting in the middle

photos.title: Heads down
photos.subtitle: White rhinoceros
photos.story: Two rhinos graze side by side, with a small bird riding on one's back. White rhinos have wide, square lips made for cropping grass.
photos.alt: Two white rhinoceroses grazing behind a green hedge, a small bird on one's back

photos.title: Bill first
photos.subtitle: Channel-billed toucan
photos.story: That huge bill looks heavy but is mostly hollow and light. Toucans also use it to shed body heat.
photos.alt: A toucan with a black bill, blue face and yellow chest perched on a mossy branch

photos.title: Gold and green
photos.subtitle: Golden parakeet
photos.story: Bright yellow with green flight feathers. In the wild it lives only in the Amazon rainforest of northern Brazil.
photos.alt: A golden-yellow parakeet with green wing feathers perched on a bare branch

photos.title: On the prowl
photos.subtitle: Lion
photos.story: A lioness walks along the rock edge, lit against a dark wall of leaves.
photos.alt: A lioness walking along a rock ledge against a dark background

photos.title: Down on its knees
photos.subtitle: Common warthog
photos.story: Warthogs kneel on thick pads on their front knees to graze and dig for roots. The curved tusks are teeth that keep growing.
photos.alt: A muddy warthog kneeling on its front knees beside large green leaves
